regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, DOI, and ESI/CCDC footnote
regions.finding: Verified the actual article title and aggregate Rh-catalyzed cross-coupling claim. The article mentions online ESI, but workspace SI association remains unestablished. CCDC 2005327 is linked as characterization of (E)-4ai rather than as an SI file or reaction.
The two-allenol Rh/Cu(OAc)2·H2O/O2 reaction is explicitly recent prior work and is classified as a literature example with no current-paper yield assigned.

Scheme 1b is a generic challenge map of possible product classes A–F, not a performed experiment. Scheme 1c shows ascorbic acid, rofecoxib, and digitoxigenin as contextual butenolide examples, not reaction products of this study.

regions.region: page 1 right-column initial 1a/2a experiment and optimization introduction
regions.finding: The initial Cu(OAc)2·H2O/O2 experiment continues as Scheme 2 on page 2 and is one record with 9% (E)-3a, 29% (E)-4aa, and three not-detected products. The prose introduces Table 1 entries 1–3 without duplicating them.

unresolved: Online ESI is mentioned but no SI file is explicitly associated in this workspace.
Generic Scheme 1 structures do not define unique compounds or experiment-specific yields.
Initial-experiment solvent volume and non-detection limits are not reported.

regions.finding: One 0.2 mmol 1a/1.5 equiv 2a experiment under Rh/Cu(OAc)2·H2O/O2 at 50 °C for 13 h gives 9% NMR (E)-3a and 29% NMR (E)-4aa; 5aa/6a/7a are not detected.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 entries 1–11 and footnotes
regions.finding: Eleven distinct optimization/control rows were retained with row oxidants/omission, 1a/2a ratios, temperatures, times, N2/O2 conditions, three product-specific NMR yields, entry-1 chlorofuranone, entry-6–10 (E)-3a side yields, and entry-9 recovery.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 entries (E)-4ba through (E)-4ao and footnotes
regions.finding: Nineteen independent substrate-scope arrows were retained with exact displayed times/yields, 0.5 mmol overrides for 4ba/4ca/4da/4ac/4ah, E/Z footnotes for 4aj/4am, shared side-product ranges, and the explicit 4ao exception.

regions.region: page 2 Table 2 X-ray panel and scope prose
regions.finding: The X-ray/CCDC panel characterizes (E)-4ai and is not another preparation or structure verification. Scope prose maps substituent classes to the same nineteen rows and creates no duplicate experiments.

unresolved: Table 2 does not state workups, purifications, product masses, or yield bases.
The shared Table 2 side-product ranges do not give row-specific exact values.
The Table 1 shared 2.0-equiv oxidant statement is ambiguous for oxygen-only rows and was preserved without interpretation.

regions.finding: The 5 mmol 1a/2i oxygen scale-up to (E)-4ai (52%) and the subsequent NaBH4/MeOH reduction of (E)-4ai to (E)-9 (95%) are two separate arrows/experiments; the latter yield is not treated as a two-step overall yield.
The air-balloon 1 mmol 1a/2i experiment gives (E)-4ai in 54%, and the separate [D]-2a labeling experiment gives [D]-(E)-4aa in 52% with >99% D at the depicted methyl position.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Scheme 4 and mechanism prose
regions.finding: IN-1, IN-2, and IN-3 belong to a proposed Rh catalytic cycle involving oxyrhodation, insertion, beta-D elimination, reductive elimination, and O2 reoxidation; they are not isolated experiments.

The acknowledgment says Weiyi Wang reproduced Table 2 products (E)-4ad, (E)-4ah, and (E)-4da but supplies no separable run details; provenance notes were attached to the existing rows. References are prior literature only.

unresolved: Scheme 3 does not state workups, purifications, product masses, or yield bases.
The isotope experiment omits absolute scale, solvent volume, and deuterium analytical method.
The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
